import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Node {
        int age;
        List<Edge> adjusted = new ArrayList<>();
        Edge back;
    }

    static class Edge {
        Node from, to;
        int flow;
        Edge opposite;
    }

    static int adjust(Edge e, int d) {
        if (e == null) return d;
        d = adjust(e.from.back, Math.min(d, e.flow));
        e.flow -= d;
        e.opposite.flow += d;
        return d;
    }

    static void connect(Node a, Node b, int w) {
        Edge ea = new Edge();
        Edge eb = new Edge();
        ea.from = a; ea.to = b; ea.flow = w; ea.opposite = eb;
        eb.from = b; eb.to = a; eb.flow = 0; eb.opposite = ea;
        a.adjusted.add(ea);
        b.adjusted.add(eb);
    }

    static int maxFlow(List<Node> g, Node source, Node sink) {
        int result = 0;
        while (true) {
            for (Node u : g) u.age = 0;
            Queue<Node> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(source);
            source.age = 1;
            while (!q.isEmpty() && sink.age == 0) {
                Node u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : u.adjusted) {
                    Node v = e.to;
                    if (v.age != 0 || e.flow == 0) continue;
                    v.back = e;
                    v.age = u.age + 1;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
            if (sink.age == 0) break;
            for (Edge e : sink.adjusted) {
                Edge o = e.opposite;
                if (o.from.age != sink.age - 1 || o.flow == 0) continue;
                result += adjust(o, o.flow);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    static long n;
    static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE / 2;

    static long linear(long t, long r, long c) {
        return t * n * n + r * n + c;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;
        String line;
        while (true) {
            line = br.readLine();
            if (line == null || line.trim().isEmpty()) break;
            st = new StringTokenizer(line);
            n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
            long T = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());

            String[] lab = new String[(int) n];
            List<Node> g = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i <= T; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n * n; j++) {
                    g.add(new Node());
                }
            }
            Node source = g.get((int) (linear(T, n - 1, n - 1) + 1));
            Node sink = g.get((int) (linear(T, n - 1, n - 1) + 2));
            List<long[]> z = new ArrayList<>();

            for (int r = 0; r < n; r++) {
                lab[r] = br.readLine();
            }

            for (int r = 0; r < n; r++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
                    char ch = lab[r].charAt(c);
                    if (ch == 'Y') continue;
                    if (ch == 'Z') {
                        z.add(new long[]{r, c});
                        continue;
                    }
                    connect(source, g.get((int) linear(0, r, c)), ch - '0');
                    lab[r] = lab[r].substring(0, c) + '0' + lab[r].substring(c + 1);
                }
            }

            for (int r = 0; r < n; r++) {
                String row = br.readLine();
                for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
                    char ch = row.charAt(c);
                    if (ch == 'Y' || ch == 'Z') continue;
                    connect(g.get((int) linear(T, r, c)), sink, ch - '0');
                }
            }

            int[] dr = {1, 0, -1, 0};
            int[] dc = {0, 1, 0, -1};

            for (long t = 0; t < T; t++) {
                // connect corridors
                for (int r = 0; r < n; r++) {
                    for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
                        connect(g.get((int) linear(t, r, c)), g.get((int) linear(t + 1, r, c)), (int) INF);
                        if (lab[r].charAt(c) != '0') continue;
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                            int r_ = r + dr[d];
                            int c_ = c + dc[d];
                            if (r_ < 0 || r_ >= n || c_ < 0 || c_ >= n) continue;
                            if (lab[r_].charAt(c_) != '0') continue;
                            connect(g.get((int) linear(t, r, c)), g.get((int) linear(t + 1, r_, c_)), (int) INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
                // spread
                List<long[]> z_ = new ArrayList<>();
                for (long[] e : z) {
                    int r = (int) e[0];
                    int c = (int) e[1];
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int r_ = r + dr[d];
                        int c_ = c + dc[d];
                        if (r_ < 0 || r_ >= n || c_ < 0 || c_ >= n) continue;
                        if (lab[r_].charAt(c_) != '0') continue;
                        z_.add(new long[]{r_, c_});
                        lab[r_] = lab[r_].substring(0, c_) + 'Z' + lab[r_].substring(c_ + 1);
                    }
                }
                z = z_;
            }
            System.out.println(maxFlow(g, source, sink));
        }
    }
}
